description: Have RepuTend watch your business's reviews on another review platform too (Trustpilot or G2), from the address of the business's profile there (for Trustpilot, the business's domain works too). RepuTend takes your word that the profile is your business's. Once it is added, RepuTend reads the profile's low-star reviews and screens each one. A business has one profile on each review site. What a person may say: "add our G2 profile to RepuTend" with its address.

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

profile.description: The profile's address on Trustpilot or G2.

name: add_profile
title: Add a review platform profile
